    About this tool

    Open source · Plain language · Accessibility

    This page is an open-source reference implementation, not an official government service, and it does not transmit your report. Extraction runs entirely in your browser using pattern matching; it will miss things and occasionally guess wrong, so every field is editable and nothing is auto-submitted.

    The interface targets WCAG 2.1 Level AAA: a single page heading and ordered outline, all text at a 7:1 contrast ratio or better, enhanced keyboard focus indicators, status and error messages in live regions, a true modal dialog with focus management, explicit labels with autocomplete on contact fields, a labeled step navigation, and a maximum line length for readability. To adapt it, edit the CONFIG block at the top of the source — branding, colors, links, the step schema, and the extraction patterns are all data.
